apps/web/components/features/admin/Scree.loading: The gallery receives an already-resolved list and has no loading branch. The detector matched loading=lazy on the thumbnail img.
apps/web/components/features/admin/Scree.offline: The gallery makes no request; images are plain links to already-resolved URLs. The detector matched the loading=lazy attribute.

apps/web/components/features/admin/outbo.permission-denied: The fact row takes no role or entitlement; the parent rail decides who reaches it. The detector matched the word role in the group role attribute.
apps/web/components/features/admin/outbo.offline: The row makes no request itself: it hands decisions to onDecision and shows the parent pending flag (LoadingDecisionPending). The detector matched the pending prop.

apps/web/components/features/alerts/Aler.empty: The landing shows a fixed PROOF_POINTS constant and no data-driven collection that could be empty. The detector matched .map( over that constant.
apps/web/components/features/alerts/Aler.permission-denied: The page is a public fan capture surface with no roles or entitlements. The detector matched the phrase lock it in in the confirmation copy.

apps/web/components/features/ask-jovie/A.permission-denied: The widget is a public profile surface open to every visitor and checks no role or entitlement. The detector matched the role field on chat messages (visitor or jovie).

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/d.permission-denied: The page denies nothing: usePlanGate only passes maxRetentionDays to TimeRangeSelector, which owns how longer ranges are offered. The detector matched the word plan in usePlanGate.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/m.offline: The card makes no request: confirm and reject are callbacks owned by the parent list, which reports in-flight work through isConfirming and isRejecting (LoadingRejecting). The detector matched the isLoading local.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.offline: The manager makes no request itself: saves, deletes and their offline failures belong to useContactsManager and the table. The detector matched the isLoading prop that gates navigation readiness (LoadingContacts).
